summary: Hold. Myanmar's first-party Settlement and Land Records Department is evidenced, and Burmese SLRD material names Bogale, but no public anonymous parcel API, stable native parcel ID, CRS, or full polygon was retrieved.

SLRD informational pages and Form 105 explanations are not parcel-level geometry or an open map service.
A timeout, 502, or lack of a visible viewer is not evidence of citywide parcel absence; no exact-point hit/miss was asserted.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only if source-proven
